```{r}
pnadc_financing <- subset(pnadc, S01017 == 2 & tenure_condition == "proprietario_formal")
```

```{r}
# 1. Converter o objeto de survey mantendo a integridade
design_tidy <- as_survey(pnadc_financing)

# 2. Categorizar, ordenar as faixas do MCMV e calcular os percentuais
tabela_mcmv_regiao <- design_tidy %>%
  mutate(
    faixa_mcmv_texto = case_when(
      household_income <= 2850 ~ "Faixa 1",
      household_income > 2850 & household_income <= 4700 ~ "Faixa 2",
      household_income > 4700 & household_income <= 8600 ~ "Faixa 3",
      household_income > 8600 ~ "Acima da Faixa 3",
      TRUE ~ "Ignorado"
    ),
    faixa_mcmv = factor(faixa_mcmv_texto, levels = c(
      "Acima da Faixa 3",
      "Faixa 3",
      "Faixa 2",
      "Faixa 1",
      "Ignorado"
    ))
  ) %>%
  group_by(macroregion, faixa_mcmv) %>%
  summarize(
    domicilios_estimados = survey_total(na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  group_by(macroregion) %>%
  mutate(
    percentual_na_regiao = (domicilios_estimados / sum(domicilios_estimados)) * 100
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# 3. Construir o gráfico 100% Stacked Column com legenda no canto inferior direito
grafico_mcmv <- ggplot(tabela_mcmv_regiao, aes(x = macroregion, y = percentual_na_regiao, fill = faixa_mcmv)) +
  geom_col() + 
  
  geom_text(
    aes(label = gsub("\\.", ",", sprintf("%.1f%%", percentual_na_regiao))), 
    position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
    color = "white",                        
    size = 3
  ) +
  
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Faixa 1" = "#2066a8", 
      "Faixa 2" = "#3594cc", 
      "Faixa 3" = "#8cc5e3", 
      "Acima da Faixa 3" = "#A0A0A0",
      "Ignorado" = "#E0E0E0"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "População projetada (%)",
    fill = "Faixas de renda (PMCMV)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    # Moves legend below the plot area
    legend.position = "right",

    legend.text = element_text(size = 11),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 13),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 11),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

print(grafico_mcmv)

ggsave(
  filename = "../outputs/chart_mcmv.png", 
  plot = grafico_mcmv,
  width = 11,      # Increase this value to stretch the chart area
  height = 5,      # Keep height standard to create a widescreen aspect ratio
  dpi = 300,       # High resolution for publications
  bg = "white"     # Ensures a white background
)
```

```{r}
compute_cv_by_bracket <- function(design_obj, threshold = 8600, region_label = "") {
  
  below <- subset(design_obj, household_income <= threshold)
  above <- subset(design_obj, household_income > threshold)
  
  summarize_segment <- function(seg_design, segment_label) {
    mean_val <- svymean(~household_income, seg_design, na.rm = TRUE)
    var_val  <- svyvar(~household_income, seg_design, na.rm = TRUE)
    
    # Index by position (1st/only element) instead of by name --
    # svyvar()'s coef() doesn't reliably carry the "household_income"
    # label the way svymean()'s does, especially for svyrep.design.
    mu  <- as.numeric(coef(mean_val))[1]
    sd_ <- sqrt(as.numeric(coef(var_val))[1])
    cv  <- sd_ / mu
    
    n_obs <- nrow(seg_design$variables)
    
    data.frame(
      Regiao  = region_label,
      Faixa   = segment_label,
      N       = n_obs,
      Media   = mu,
      DP      = sd_,
      CV      = cv
    )
  }
  
  rbind(
    summarize_segment(below, paste0("<= R$", format(threshold, big.mark = ".", scientific = FALSE))),
    summarize_segment(above, paste0("> R$", format(threshold, big.mark = ".", scientific = FALSE)))
  )
}

cv_sul     <- compute_cv_by_bracket(pnadc_financing_sul, threshold = 8600, region_label = "Sul")
cv_sudeste <- compute_cv_by_bracket(pnadc_financing_sudeste, threshold = 8600, region_label = "Sudeste")

cv_comparison <- rbind(cv_sul, cv_sudeste)
print(cv_comparison)
```
